fomod.Name: No Asteroids - Mod Menu
fomod.Author: Timour
fomod.Description: In-game HOME-key mod menu: price multiplier x2/x4/x6/x8/x16, infinite credits toggle, tool upgrade level cap x2/x4 (HIT POWER/TEMPO/SWEEP/LUCK past 20), Lance+Slicer 10/s fire rate, live sale + tool stat readouts. Install the menu with Install-Mod-Menu.bat after deployment.
